SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".uuid) AS "count" FROM "cards" AS "c" INNER JOIN "foreign_data" AS "f" ON "f".uuid = "c".uuid WHERE "c".colors = 'B' AND "c".types LIKE '%Artifact%' AND "f".language IS NOT NULL AND "f".flavortext IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("f".flavortext) <> '' LIMIT 501
SELECT "u".displayname FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".lasteditoruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "h".userid FROM "posthistory" AS "h" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "h".postid INNER JOIN (SELECT postid, userid FROM "posthistory" WHERE userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY postid, userid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AS "single_entry" ON "single_entry".postid = "h".postid AND "single_entry".userid = "h".userid WHERE "p".viewcount >= 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2010) / COUNT(*) - 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2011) / COUNT(*) AS "difference_percentage_points" FROM "badges" WHERE name = 'Student' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tags ILIKE '%<r>%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" WHERE owneruserid = -1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "u".displayname FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' ORDER BY "p".favoritecount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT "p".viewcount, "u".displayname FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".lasteditoruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".title = 'Computer game datasets' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".text, COALESCE("u".displayname, "c".userdisplayname) AS "author_display_name" FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".postid LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "c".userid WHERE "p".title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY "c".creationdate DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".score > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "c".postid FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".postid GROUP BY "c".postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX("c".score) = 0) AS "single_zero_score_posts" LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE owneruserid IS NOT NULL) AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%United Kingdom%' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".age)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_age" FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "c".userid WHERE "c".text LIKE '%http://%' AND "u".age IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "organizer".userid, "organizer".date FROM "badges" AS "organizer" INNER JOIN "users" ON "users".id = "organizer".userid WHERE "organizer".name = 'Organizer' AND "users".location = 'Germany' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "badges" AS "earlier" WHERE "earlier".userid = "organizer".userid AND "earlier".date < "organizer".date) >= 5) AS "qualifying" LIMIT 501

WITH "first_posts" AS (SELECT owneruserid, MIN(creaiondate) AS "first_created" FROM "posts" WHERE owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY owneruserid) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_posts" AS "fp" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "fp".owneruserid WHERE "fp".first_created >= '2010-01-01' AND "fp".first_created < '2011-01-01' AND "u".location ILIKE '%India%' AND ("u".location = 'India' OR "u".location ILIKE '%, India' OR "u".location ILIKE '%, India,%' OR "u".location ILIKE '%, India') LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)) FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".tags ILIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".score < 20 LIMIT 501

WITH "posts_2012" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".score, "p".lasteditoruserid FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p"."creaiondate" >= '2012-01-01' AND "p"."creaiondate" < '2013-01-01'), "germany_editors" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".lasteditoruserid AS "userid" FROM "posts_2012" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%') SELECT (SELECT SUM("p".score) FROM "posts_2012" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%') AS "germany_last_editor_posts_total_score", (SELECT SUM("p".score) FROM "posts_2012" AS "p" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "users" AS "u" WHERE "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid AND "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%')) AS "all_other_posts_total_score", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "germany_editors") AS "germany_based_last_editors_count", (SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM "germany_editors" AS "g" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "g".userid) AS "combined_reputation" LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "p".owneruserid FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".score = 10 AND "p".tags ~ '(^|<)r(>|$)' AND "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL) AS "owners" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "owners".owneruserid LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".lasactivitydate >= '2014-08-27' AND "p".lasactivitydate < '2014-08-28' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("linking".score) AS "total_score" FROM "posts" AS "target" INNER JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".relatedpostid = "target".id INNER JOIN "posts" AS "linking" ON "linking".id = "pl".postid WHERE "target".title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?' AND "linking".tags LIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

WITH "germany_users" AS (SELECT id, displayname FROM "users" WHERE location = 'Germany'), "badge_totals" AS (SELECT "gu".id, "gu".displayname, COUNT("b".id) AS "badge_total" FROM "germany_users" AS "gu" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "gu".id GROUP BY "gu".id, "gu".displayname), "ranked_totals" AS (SELECT badge_total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS "total_rank" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT badge_total FROM "badge_totals") AS "distinct_totals") SELECT "bt".displayname, "bt".badge_total FROM "badge_totals" AS "bt" INNER JOIN "ranked_totals" AS "rt" ON "rt".badge_total = "bt".badge_total WHERE "rt".total_rank = 2 ORDER BY "bt".displayname ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%CA%' AND views = (SELECT MAX(views) FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%CA%') LIMIT 501

SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%York%' AND (location ILIKE '%England%' OR location = 'York') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE location ILIKE '%York%' AND (location ILIKE '%England%' OR location = 'York')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".id) FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'India' AND "b".name = 'Yearling' AND "b".date < '2014-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".displayname) FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "b".name = 'Supporter' AND "u".age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".title, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".postid = "p".id THEN "l".relatedpostid WHEN "l".relatedpostid = "p".id THEN "l".postid END) AS "related_post_count" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "l" ON "l".postid = "p".id OR "l".relatedpostid = "p".id WHERE "p".title ILIKE '%principal component scores%' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".postid = "p".id THEN "l".relatedpostid WHEN "l".relatedpostid = "p".id THEN "l".postid END) = (SELECT MAX(link_count) FROM (SELECT "p2".id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l2".postid = "p2".id THEN "l2".relatedpostid WHEN "l2".relatedpostid = "p2".id THEN "l2".postid END) AS "link_count" FROM "posts" AS "p2" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "l2" ON "l2".postid = "p2".id OR "l2".relatedpostid = "p2".id WHERE "p2".title ILIKE '%principal component scores%' GROUP BY "p2".id) AS "counts") ORDER BY "p".title ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "id" FROM "users" WHERE "displayname" = 'Michael' AND "age" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "age" ASC, "id" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2011-01-01') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'India' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".upvote_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_up_votes_cast", ROUND(AVG("x".age)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_age" FROM (SELECT "p".owneruserid, "u".age, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "votes" AS "v" WHERE "v".userid = "p".owneruserid AND "v".votetypeid = 2) AS "upvote_count" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p"."creaiondate" >= '2012-01-01' AND "p"."creaiondate" < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY "p".owneruserid, "u".age HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(post_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_posts_per_month" FROM (SELECT "months".month_num, COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) AS "post_count" FROM (SELECT 1 AS "month_num" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8) AS "months" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".creationdate >= TIMESTAMP '2010-01-01' + ("months".month_num - 1) * INTERVAL '1 month' AND "pl".creationdate < TIMESTAMP '2010-01-01' + "months".month_num * INTERVAL '1 month' LEFT JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid AND "p".answercount <= 2 WHERE "pl".id IS NULL OR "p".id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "months".month_num UNION ALL SELECT "months".month_num, COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) AS "post_count" FROM (SELECT 9 AS "month_num" UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12) AS "months" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".creationdate >= TIMESTAMP '2010-01-01' + ("months".month_num - 1) * INTERVAL '1 month' AND "pl".creationdate < TIMESTAMP '2010-01-01' + "months".month_num * INTERVAL '1 month' LEFT JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid AND "p".answercount <= 2 WHERE "pl".id IS NULL OR "p".id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "months".month_num) AS "monthly" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "u".reputation < 1000 OR "u".reputation IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "u".displayname, COUNT(*) AS "edit_comments" FROM "posthistory" AS "ph" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "ph".userid WHERE "ph".postid = 118 AND "ph".posthistorytypeid IN (4, 5) AND "ph".comment IS NOT NULL AND "ph".comment <> '' GROUP BY "u".displayname ORDER BY edit_comments DESC, "u".displayname ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "y".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".segment, "y".customerid), "ranked" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM "totals"), "chosen" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM "chosen" LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301') AS "consumption_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401') AS "consumption_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "changes" AS (SELECT segment, (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 AS "increase_percentage" FROM "totals") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "changes" WHERE increase_percentage = (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) FROM "changes") OR increase_percentage = (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) FROM "changes") ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(((SUM(CASE WHEN "date" >= '201301' AND "date" < '201401' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201301' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201301' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0))::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 6718 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2012" ON "y2012".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2013" ON "y2013".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y2012".date >= '201201' AND "y2012".date < '201301' AND "y2013".date >= '201301' AND "y2013".date < '201401' LIMIT 501

WITH "active_customers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND date < DATE '2013-01-01'), "annual_consumption" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '201201' AND date < '201301' GROUP BY customerid) SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "active_customers" AS "a" ON "a".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "annual_consumption" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".total_consumption < 30000 GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "customers_who_consumed_fuel_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t"."date" + "t"."time"::TIME) - MIN("t"."date" + "t"."time"::TIME))) / 60) AS "elapsed_whole_minutes" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "t".gasstationid = "g".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT customerid FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '201301' AND date < '201312' AND consumption > 0 GROUP BY customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date) = 11) AS "active" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "active".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

WITH "q2" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "quarter_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '201304' AND date <= '201306' GROUP BY customerid) SELECT ROUND(AVG("q".quarter_consumption) FILTER (WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "eur_average", ROUND(AVG("q".quarter_consumption) FILTER (WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "czk_average" FROM "q2" AS "q" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "q".customerid LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(MAX(monthly_total) FILTER (WHERE year = '2013') - MAX(monthly_total) FILTER (WHERE year = '2012'))::INTEGER AS "difference" FROM (SELECT LEFT(date, 4) AS "year", date, SUM(consumption) AS "monthly_total" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE LEFT(date, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY LEFT(date, 4), date) AS "monthly" LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_monthly_fuel_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 15621 AND "date" LIKE '2013%' AND consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(customer_avg) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK') - AVG(customer_avg) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR')) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid, "c".currency, AVG("ym".consumption) AS "customer_avg" FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "ym".customerid WHERE "ym".date >= '201201' AND "ym".date < '201301' GROUP BY "c".customerid, "c".currency) AS "customer_consumption" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualified_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customerid) FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "t".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'SME' AND "t".date >= DATE '2013-02-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-03-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(away_wins) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "away_wins" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "m2".league_id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "win_counts") ORDER BY "t".team_long_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" WHERE "pa".jumping >= 80 AND "pa".date::DATE >= DATE '2007-02-22' AND "pa".date::DATE < DATE '2007-08-31' LIMIT 501

WITH "last_match" AS (SELECT GREATEST("m".date::DATE, "m".date::DATE) AS "match_date", "m".home_team_api_id, "m".away_team_api_id FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id OR "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id WHERE "t".team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND "m".season = '2012/2013' ORDER BY "m".date::DATE DESC LIMIT 1), "team_id" AS (SELECT team_api_id FROM "team" WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge') SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team_id" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id CROSS JOIN "last_match" AS "lm" WHERE "ta".date::DATE <= "lm".match_date ORDER BY "ta".date::DATE DESC LIMIT 1

WITH "dated_ratings" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".overall_rating, "pa".defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" WHERE "pa".date::DATE <= DATE '2013-07-12' AND "pa".overall_rating IS NOT NULL AND "pa".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date::DATE DESC), "ratings_on_date" AS (SELECT "dr".player_api_id, "dr".overall_rating FROM "dated_ratings" AS "dr" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "dr".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Landon Donovan'), "all_players_avg" AS (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS "avg_rating" FROM "dated_ratings") SELECT ROUND((("r".overall_rating - "a".avg_rating) / "a".avg_rating * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "ratings_on_date" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "all_players_avg" AS "a" LIMIT 501

WITH "salary_extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(a12) AS "min_salary", MAX(a12) AS "max_salary" FROM "district"), "lowest_salary_district" AS (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a12 = (SELECT min_salary FROM "salary_extremes")), "oldest_female_clients" AS (SELECT "c".client_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "lowest_salary_district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' ORDER BY "c".birth_date ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "d".account_id, (SELECT max_salary - min_salary FROM "salary_extremes") AS "salary_difference" FROM "oldest_female_clients" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 501

WITH "target_district" AS (SELECT "d".district_id FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "target_district" AS "td" ON "c".district_id = "td".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ("end_trans".balance - "start_trans".balance) * 100.0 / "start_trans".balance AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "start_trans" ON "start_trans".account_id = "l".account_id AND "start_trans".date = DATE '1993-03-22' INNER JOIN "trans" AS "end_trans" ON "end_trans".account_id = "l".account_id AND "end_trans".date = DATE '1998-12-27' WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND(((("d".a13 - "d".a12) / "d".a12) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status = 'D' AND "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a12 <> 0 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "disp" AS "p" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "p".type <> 'OWNER' AND "d".a11 > 8000 AND "d".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "p".type LIMIT 501

WITH "yearly" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) AS "year", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)) SELECT (MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE year = 1997) - MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE year = 1996)) * 100.0 / MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE year = 1996) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "yearly" LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT MIN(date) AS "start_date" FROM "account"), "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "f" WHERE "a".date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".start_date)::DATE AND "a".date < (DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".start_date) + INTERVAL '1 month')::DATE), "ranked" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a8 AS "population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "districts" AS "x" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "x".district_id) SELECT a2, population FROM "ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "t".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR BTRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC LIMIT 5), "district_burden" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".a2, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount) FILTER (WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0) AS "avg_active_loan" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "td".district_id, "td".a2) SELECT a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(avg_active_loan) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "district_burden" WHERE avg_active_loan = (SELECT MAX(avg_active_loan) FROM "district_burden") ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "l".amount FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day') >= DATE '1995-12-31'), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC AS "district_avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "served" ON "served".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "qualifying_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d"."a11")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."district_id" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp"."client_id" = "c"."client_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "cd" ON "cd"."district_id" = "c"."district_id" WHERE "owner_disp"."type" = 'OWNER' AND "cd"."a3" = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca"."disp_id" = "account_disp"."disp_id" WHERE "account_disp"."account_id" = "owner_disp"."account_id")) AS "target_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "target_districts"."district_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "older_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "older_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".trans_id END) AS "household_payments", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND "t".k_symbol <> '' AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' THEN "t".trans_id END) AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed", "owner_client".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id AND "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "owner_client" ON "owner_client".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date, "owner_client".district_id), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "outside_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("c".outside_counterparties, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "d".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "d".a11 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowing" AS "b" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "b".home_district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "c" ON "c".account_id = "b".account_id ORDER BY "d".a11 DESC, "b".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "qualifying" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a13 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "ca".disp_id = "card_disp".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "card_disp".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "card_disp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "av" ON "a".account_id = "av".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "av".avg_balance > 1000 AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "gender_summary" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", AVG(salary) AS "avg_salary", AVG(urban_ratio) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "gs".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", "gs".district_count, "q".district_id, "q".inhabitants, ROUND("gs".avg_salary::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND("gs".avg_urban_ratio::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio" FROM "gender_summary" AS "gs" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".gender = "gs".gender AND "q".inhabitants = "gs".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "gs".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "q".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id AND "o".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "o".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_owner" AS (SELECT "d".disp_id, "d".account_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "d".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "d".type = 'OWNER'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "eligible_owner"), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "qd".district_id, "di".a3 AS "region", "di".a2 AS "district_name", "di".a8 AS "inhabitants", "di".a11 AS "average_salary", "di".a13 AS "unemployment_1996" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "qd".district_id) SELECT "dm".region, ROUND(AVG("dm".average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("dm".unemployment_1996)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG("dm".district_name ORDER BY "dm".inhabitants DESC, "dm".district_name ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM "district_metrics" AS "dm" GROUP BY "dm".region LIMIT 501

WITH "card_holders" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca".type, "cl".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id), "district_population" AS (SELECT "ch".type, "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card_holders" AS "ch" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ch".district_id), "minima" AS (SELECT type, MIN(inhabitants) AS "inhabitants" FROM "district_population" GROUP BY type) SELECT "dp".type, "dp".a2 AS "home_district", "dp".inhabitants FROM "district_population" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "minima" AS "m" ON "m".type = "dp".type AND "m".inhabitants = "dp".inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "dp".type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, "dp".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region")), "latest_tx" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "o".account_id, "o".district_id, "o".district_name, "lt".balance FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "latest_tx" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id), "district_stats" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG(balance::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_end_balance" FROM "account_balances" GROUP BY district_id, district_name) SELECT district_name, accounts_opened, average_end_balance FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a4, "d".a11 FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id), "most_populous" AS (SELECT district_id, a4, a11 FROM "district_set" ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT district_id, a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", (SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11::NUMERIC), 2) FROM "district_set") AS "average_yearly_salary" FROM "most_populous" LIMIT 501

WITH "district_population" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000), "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_order_debits" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "total_standing_order_debit" FROM "order" AS "o" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "o".account_id WHERE "o".k_symbol IS NULL OR "o".k_symbol = '' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "qualified" AS (SELECT "dp".district_id, "dp".district_name, "dp".region, "dp".population, "w".total_amount_withdrawn, "w".total_amount_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "dp".population AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("so".total_standing_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / "da".account_count AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_population" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "withdrawals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "dp".district_id INNER JOIN "district_accounts" AS "da" ON "da".district_id = "dp".district_id LEFT JOIN "standing_order_debits" AS "so" ON "so".district_id = "dp".district_id) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_amount_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "qualified" ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" WHERE "dp".client_id = 3541), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "hd".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "hd".a3), "district_ranked" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".district_id ASC) AS "top_district_name", FIRST_VALUE("d".a8) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".district_id ASC) AS "top_district_inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d"), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rs".client_count AS "clients_in_region", "dr".top_district_name, "dr".top_district_inhabitants, "dr".population_rank FROM "client_accounts" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ca".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".client_id = 3541 INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "district_ranked" AS "dr" ON "dr".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "d".a3 LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "lent_amount" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "year", district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(lent_amount) AS "amount_lent", SUM(lent_amount)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER, district_id) SELECT year::TEXT AS "year", SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "l".account_id AND "tr".date = "l".date ORDER BY "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH "card_clients" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", "di".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "di".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "loan_summary" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "profiled" AS (SELECT "cc".client_id, "cc".gender, "cc".birth_date, "cc".card_type, "cc".age_at_issue, COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("ls".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN "cc".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary FROM "card_clients" AS "cc" LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "cc".account_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "profiled" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".loan_id = 98832 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823) AS "client_accounts" ON "client_accounts".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "regional_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ld" ON "ld".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ld".a3 = "d".a3) AS "region_loan_count", AVG("d".a10)::NUMERIC AS "region_avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" GROUP BY "d".a3), "loan_candidates" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".birth_date, "ad".a2 AS "branch_district", "ad".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT lc.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "lc".amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "loan_candidates" AS "lc"), "account_activity" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "rl".client_id, "rl".amount AS "loan_amount", "rl".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("rl".payments::NUMERIC * "rl".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("rl".payments::NUMERIC * "rl".duration) - "rl".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "rl".status AS "loan_status", "rl".branch_district, "rl".region, COALESCE("aa".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("aa".total_deposits, 0) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("aa".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "rl".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("aa".total_deposits, 0) > "rl".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rs".region_loan_count, ROUND("rs".region_avg_salary, 2) AS "region_avg_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "rl".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "ranked_loans" AS "rl" LEFT JOIN "account_activity" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "rl".account_id INNER JOIN "regional_stats" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "rl".region WHERE "rl".amount_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "rl".amount DESC, "rl".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a11 AS "population" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_exposure" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, region, MAX(population) AS "population", COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "qualifying_accounts" GROUP BY district_id, district_name, region), "region_summary" AS (SELECT region, STRING_AGG(district_name, ', ' ORDER BY district_name ASC) AS "districts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM(population) AS "combined_population", SUM(account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district_exposure" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, districts, district_count, combined_population, account_count FROM "region_summary" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a6::NUMERIC AS "salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a6) SELECT COUNT("a".account_id) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", COUNT(DISTINCT "q".district_id) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".salary), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "q".district_id WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_summary" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_summary" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "account_metrics" AS (SELECT "ga".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("ts".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("ts".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("ts".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ga".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_summary" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ga".account_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, number_of_loans, external_counterparties, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account_metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "ca".card_id, "dp".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".client_id, "d".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id AND "c".type = 'classic' WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER'), "district_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY district_id), "payments" AS (SELECT "e".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_account_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "e".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".district_id) SELECT "district".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("district_counts".client_count, 0) AS "client_count", COALESCE("payments".external_account_count, 0) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE("payments".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" LEFT JOIN "district_counts" ON "district_counts".district_id = "district".district_id LEFT JOIN "payments" ON "payments".district_id = "district".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C' LIMIT 501

SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(salary)) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort' WHEN "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31' THEN 'old cohort' END AS "cohort", "d".a11 AS "salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31') AS "cohort_salaries" GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(((MAX(CASE WHEN raceid = 853 THEN CAST(fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) END) - MAX(CASE WHEN raceid = 854 THEN CAST(fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN raceid = 854 THEN CAST(fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) END)) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r".raceid IN (853, 854) AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE positionorder <> 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

WITH "wins" AS (SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) AS "race_wins" FROM "results" WHERE position = 1 GROUP BY driverid), "top_winners" AS (SELECT driverid, race_wins FROM "wins" WHERE race_wins = (SELECT MAX(race_wins) FROM "wins")) SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_driver_standings_points" FROM "top_winners" AS "tw" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "tw".driverid INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "tw".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) * 100.0 / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "winner".position = 1 AND "last_finisher".laps = (SELECT MAX("res".laps) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid) AND "last_finisher".position = (SELECT MAX("res".position) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position IS NOT NULL AND "res".laps = "last_finisher".laps) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "ra".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds)::NUMERIC / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / COUNT(*) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".points, "co".name, "co".nationality FROM "constructorresults" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "c".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "co" ON "c".constructorid = "co".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 ORDER BY "c".points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".year = 2008 AND "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "shortest_lap_milliseconds" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "l".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY shortest_lap_milliseconds ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, TO_CHAR((MIN("lt".milliseconds) / 60000)::INT, 'FM00') || ':' || TO_CHAR(((MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000)::INT, 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR(MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 1000, 'FM000') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "ra".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("race_stops".stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".raceid NOT IN (SELECT "r2000".raceid FROM "races" AS "r2000" WHERE "r2000".year = 2000) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_stops" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT("q".q3) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY COUNT("q".q3) DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "race" AS (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE year = 1995 AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'), "qualifying_times" AS (SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "q".q1, MAX("q".q1) OVER () AS "slowest_q1" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "q".q1 IS NOT NULL) SELECT driverref, nationality, dob, q1 FROM "qualifying_times" WHERE q1 = slowest_q1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q2".driverid) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q1" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q1".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d1" ON "q1".driverid = "d1".driverid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q2" ON "q1".raceid = "q2".raceid AND "q1".position < "q2".position WHERE "r".year = 2010 AND "d1".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d1".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "q1".position IS NOT NULL AND "q2".position IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2_inner".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2_inner" WHERE "q2_inner".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2_inner".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "runners_up_count" FROM "races" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "r".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) >= 2 ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR("r".date + ("r".time::TIME) + ("res".milliseconds * INTERVAL '1 millisecond'), 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "finish_local_time", "d".url FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT q2_time FROM (SELECT DISTINCT q2 AS "q2_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q2q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2q".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q2 ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS "second_time") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 < '1:40.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_count), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM (SELECT "d".driverid, COUNT("q".q3) AS "q3_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid) AS "driver_q3_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared_names" ON "shared_names".forename = "d".forename WHERE "d".code IS NULL AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 LIKE '%:%' AND (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT driverid, raceid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "res".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, ("lap".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("lap".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("lap".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "lap".fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN "lap".fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("lap".fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" GROUP BY raceid, driverid) AS "lap" ON "lap".raceid = "r".raceid AND "lap".fastest_ms < 90000 LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lap".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob > DATE '1980-12-31' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 2) ~ '^[0-9][0-9][.][0-9][0-9][0-9]$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "q2".driverid = "d2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob > DATE '1980-12-31' AND "q2".q3 <> '' AND split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2) ~ '^[0-9][0-9][.][0-9][0-9][0-9]$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "lt".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("lt2".milliseconds) FROM "laptimes" AS "lt2" WHERE "lt2".raceid = "lt".raceid AND "lt2".driverid = "lt".driverid) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "lt3".milliseconds) FROM "laptimes" AS "lt3" WHERE "lt3".raceid = "lt".raceid AND "lt3".milliseconds < "lt".milliseconds) = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1) = '1' ORDER BY split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "season_totals" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "constructorstandings" AS "cs" ON "cs".constructorid = "c".constructorid LEFT JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, "r".year), "career" AS (SELECT constructorid, name, url, COALESCE(SUM(season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "season_totals" GROUP BY constructorid, name, url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "res".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM "qualifying" WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".rank = 1 THEN "c".constructorid END) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year AS "season", COUNT("p".raceid) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 LIKE '%:%' AND split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part(split_part("q".q1, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER + ('0.' || split_part("q".q1, '.', 2))::NUMERIC > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "p".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "p2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') ORDER BY "d".surname ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "winners" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "r".driverid FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "chosen_driver" AS (SELECT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality FROM "winners" AS "w" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "w".driverid ORDER BY "d".dob ASC, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name, "ra".date FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "cd".forename || ' ' || "cd".surname AS "full_name", "cd".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_win_date", COUNT("r".resultid) AS "races_started" FROM "chosen_driver" AS "cd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "cd".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 GROUP BY "cd".forename, "cd".surname, "cd".nationality, "fw".name, "fw".date LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "q".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "q".position ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 LIKE '%:%' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 LIKE '%:%') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".position = (SELECT MIN("q2".position) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "r".time, "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".name = 'Shanghai International Circuit' AND "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "res".position = 2 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "r".time ASC, "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "races".year, "drivers".forename, "drivers".surname, "results".time FROM "races" INNER JOIN "circuits" ON "races".circuitid = "circuits".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" ON "results".driverid = "drivers".driverid WHERE "races".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "races".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "races".time <= '17:00:00' AND "results".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 < '1:38.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".circuitref AS "earliest_circuitref", "c2".circuitref AS "latest_circuitref", 55800 AS "gap_seconds" FROM "circuits" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "circuits" AS "c2" WHERE "c".circuitref = 'fuji' AND "c2".circuitref = 'americas' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "res".statusid = "st".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "st".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND SUBSTRING("x".expense_date, 6, 2) IN ('09', '10') GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "totals" LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501
