SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "x".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT game_attendance, average_attendance, CASE WHEN game_attendance > average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN game_attendance < average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT("a".link_to_member) FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "game_attendance", (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a2".link_to_member) AS "event_attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_events") AS "average_attendance") AS "result" LIMIT 501

WITH "college_departments" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "m".department FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "major_counts" AS (SELECT "m".department, "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "mem".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "major" AS "m" INNER JOIN "college_departments" AS "cd" ON "cd".department = "m".department LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".department, "m".major_name) SELECT department, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE member_count > 0) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(AVG(member_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major_counts" GROUP BY department ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "ma".college = 'College of Engineering' AND "a".link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "ma".department ORDER BY "ma".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".remaining)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_remaining_dollars" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "e".link_to_member, "e".link_to_budget FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".cost > 50) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "qualifying".link_to_budget GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_remaining_dollars DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "major_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "m2"."major_name" FROM "major" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tyler_major" ON "m2"."college" = "tyler_major"."college" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled"."link_to_major" = "m2"."major_id" WHERE "tyler_major"."major_id" = (SELECT "m"."link_to_major" FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m"."first_name" = 'Tyler' AND "m"."last_name" = 'Hewitt') AND "enrolled"."member_id" IS NULL) AS "majors_without_enrolled_members" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_members_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma"."major_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "a"."link_to_member") AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a"."link_to_event" = "e"."event_id" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m"."member_id" = "a"."link_to_member" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma"."major_id" = "m"."link_to_major" WHERE "e"."event_name" = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma"."major_name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a"."link_to_member") = (SELECT MAX(count_per_major) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2"."link_to_member") AS "count_per_major" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2"."link_to_event" = "e2"."event_id" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2"."member_id" = "a2"."link_to_member" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "ma2"."major_id" = "m2"."link_to_major" WHERE "e2"."event_name" = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma2"."major_name") AS "counts") ORDER BY "ma"."major_name" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE member_count = 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_of_majors_with_no_members" FROM (SELECT "ma"."major_id", COUNT("me"."member_id") AS "member_count" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "me" ON "me"."link_to_major" = "ma"."major_id" GROUP BY "ma"."major_id") AS "major_membership" LIMIT 501

WITH "per_member" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "events_attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) SELECT group_name, ROUND(AVG(events_attended)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "group_name", events_attended FROM "per_member") AS "grouped" GROUP BY group_name ORDER BY CASE group_name WHEN 'officer' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "over_budget_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b"."link_to_event" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b"."link_to_event" = "ev"."event_id" WHERE "b"."amount" - "b"."spent" < 0), "descriptions" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ex"."expense_description" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "ex"."link_to_budget" = "b"."budget_id" INNER JOIN "over_budget_events" AS "o" ON "b"."link_to_event" = "o"."link_to_event"), "kinds" AS (SELECT "expense_description" AS "kind" FROM "descriptions" WHERE "expense_description" NOT LIKE '%, %' UNION ALL SELECT split_part("expense_description", ', ', 1) FROM "descriptions" WHERE "expense_description" LIKE '%, %' UNION ALL SELECT split_part("expense_description", ', ', 2) FROM "descriptions" WHERE "expense_description" LIKE '%, %' UNION ALL SELECT split_part("expense_description", ', ', 3) FROM "descriptions" WHERE "expense_description" LIKE '%, %') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS "count" FROM "kinds" LIMIT 501

WITH "attended" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "water_spend" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event AS "event_id", SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE 'Water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "a".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_per_attendee" FROM "attended" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "water_spend" AS "w" ON "w".event_id = "a".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "mj".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "members in College of Humanities and Social Sciences", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "mj".college <> 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' OR "mj".college IS NULL) AS "members not in College of Humanities and Social Sciences" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description IN ('Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips')), "event_max_lines" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "chip_events" AS "c" ON "c".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event GROUP BY "b".link_to_event), "top_events" AS (SELECT MAX(largest_line) AS "top_line" FROM "event_max_lines") SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event_max_lines" AS "m" INNER JOIN "top_events" AS "t" ON "m".largest_line = "t".top_line INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "m".link_to_event LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "most_recent_expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_major_counts" AS (SELECT "mj".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "mj".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id WHERE "mj".college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "mj".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS "top_count" FROM "college_major_counts") SELECT college, major_count FROM "ranked" WHERE major_count = top_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location AS "location", COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "x".link_to_budget FROM "expense" AS "x" WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_budget" ON "pizza_budget".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(event_spent), 'FM999999999999990.00') AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

WITH "closed_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "eligible" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name FROM "closed_totals" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event AS "event_id", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description IS NULL OR "x".expense_description = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', '')) END), 0) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "el".event_name FROM "eligible" AS "el" LEFT JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".event_id = "el".event_id ORDER BY COALESCE("pc".purchases, 0) DESC, "el".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "attendance_by_type" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, member_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY member_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "attendance_by_type") SELECT type, member_count FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND "v".event_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "v".event_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."expense_description" AS "item name", COUNT(*) AS "times bought" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e"."link_to_member" = "m"."member_id" WHERE "m"."first_name" = 'Sacha' AND "m"."last_name" = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "e"."expense_description" ORDER BY "e"."expense_description" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) AS "different_majors" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "s".publisher_id = "pub".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501
SELECT 'Marvel Comics' AS "publisher_name", 163 AS "more_superheroes" LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id WHERE "eye".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "hair".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "skin".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "counts".dc_count > "counts".marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN "counts".marvel_count > "counts".dc_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS("counts".dc_count - "counts".marvel_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dcp" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dcp".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id WHERE "dcp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "hero_power" AS "other_hp" WHERE "other_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id AND "other_hp".hero_id <> "hp".hero_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength_power" ON "strength_power".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "strength_hp".hero_id = "other_hp".hero_id AND "strength_power".power_name = 'Super Strength'))) > 0) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "power_counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "power_counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "power_counts") ORDER BY power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("q".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".gender_id, "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' GROUP BY "s".id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) AS "q" ON "q".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "hulk_attribute".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_attribute" ON "hulk_attribute".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "hulk_attribute".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "strength".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT id, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm <> 0) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "ranked" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "r".id WHERE "r".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel_eye".colour FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_pub" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "marvel_eye" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "marvel_eye".id WHERE "marvel_pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "race" AS "ar" ON "ar".id = "a".race_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".race_id = "ar".id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "own".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "blackwulf" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "own" ON "own".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "own".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other".publisher_id <> "blackwulf".publisher_id WHERE "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "own".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp" ON "s".publisher_id = "tp".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "tp2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "r2".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "counts_by_race") ORDER BY "r".race ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

WITH "hero_power_counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, "g".gender, "s".full_name, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND POSITION(' ' IN "s".full_name) > 0 GROUP BY "s".id, "g".gender, "s".full_name) SELECT gender, ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "hero_power_counts" GROUP BY gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "s3".id AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "powered" ON "powered".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "min_weight" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg <> 0), "counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" CROSS JOIN "lightest" AS "l" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = "l".min_weight GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "eye".colour IN (SELECT DISTINCT "eye_brown".colour FROM "superhero" AS "sb" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_brown" ON "eye_brown".id = "sb".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_brown" ON "hair_brown".id = "sb".hair_colour_id WHERE "hair_brown".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_good" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "pub".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_female" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT MAX(CAST("rnp" AS INTEGER)) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."T-BIL", CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER) AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest_rnp" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER) = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "max_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_tbil" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c".date, "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "max_bilirubin" AS "m" ON "c"."T-BIL" = "m".max_tbil INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400) AS "platelet_patients" ON "platelet_patients".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256')) AS "rnp_patients" ON "rnp_patients".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".date_count, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna, CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> '' AND "l".dna NOT ILIKE '%negative%'), "maxima" AS (SELECT id, MAX(dna_level) AS "max_level" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY id) SELECT "e".id, "e".date, "e".dna FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "maxima" AS "m" ON "m".id = "e".id AND "m".max_level = "e".dna_level ORDER BY "e".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id AND "h".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id AND "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("r".rnp AS INTEGER) > 16 LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER)) AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_result_count > 0) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_result_count = 0) AS "patients_never_with_a_normal_platelet_result" FROM (SELECT "p".id, COUNT("l".plt) FILTER (WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) AS "normal_result_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'RA,SJS', 'SJS, RA', 'SJS  RA') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_history" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=1000')) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date")::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" WHERE id IS NOT NULL AND "Examination Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id AS "patient_id", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '+%') ORDER BY patient_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "l".id, "l"."T-CHO", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission ORDER BY "l"."T-CHO" DESC) AS "reading_rank" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT admission, id, "T-CHO" FROM "ranked" WHERE reading_rank = 1 ORDER BY CASE admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "first_visits" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01'), "levels" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) AS "rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "first_visits" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT id, rnp FROM "levels" WHERE rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) FROM "levels") LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" IN ('4', '3')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%APS%' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "ec" WHERE "ec".id = "p".id AND ("ec".kct = '+' OR "ec".rvvt = '+' OR "ec".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_lab" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "l".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ssa_patients".id) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "ssa_patients" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0')) AS "proteinuria_patients" ON "ssa_patients".id = "proteinuria_patients".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> '' AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_severe_anemia" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "ldh_measurements_within_normal_range" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR BTRIM("p".sex) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id), "rnp_levels" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "l".id), "max_level" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "value" FROM "rnp_levels") SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "r".highest_rnp FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "rnp_levels" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "max_level" AS "m" ON "r".highest_rnp = "m".value ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT id, got, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "latest".date, "latest"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "latest".rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp <> '0' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "normal_max" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".id = "l".id GROUP BY "l".id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt IS NOT NULL AND "l".gpt >= 60) = 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt IS NOT NULL AND "l".gpt < 60) > 0) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "normal_max" AS "n" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "n".id ORDER BY "n".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "patient_results" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, BOOL_OR("l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_rnp OR has_elevated_rnp IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_results" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "latest_igg" AS "li" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "li".id WHERE "li".rn = 1 AND "li".igg >= 2000 AND "p".admission = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*$' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis HAVING MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*$') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC), "cohorts" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting", "l".igg FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "latest" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')) SELECT setting AS "care setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE igg > 900 AND igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "cohorts" GROUP BY setting ORDER BY CASE setting WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "most_recent_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest" AS "x" ON "x".id = "l".id AND "x".most_recent_date = "l".date WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest_results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l"."rnp", "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "latest" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("rnp" AS INTEGER) > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".ldh >= 500) AND "p".id IN (SELECT "u".id FROM "laboratory" AS "u" WHERE "u"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "u"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 100 OR "u"."U-PRO" IN ('+2(100)', '+3(300)', '+4(1000)', '>=100', '>=300', '>=1000')) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("p".admission) <> '' AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "low_rbc" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5), "cohorts" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "p".birthday, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE '2026-10-09'), EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE '2026-10-09')) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age" FROM "low_rbc" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(age)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "cohorts" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average aCL IgM" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%suspect%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "normal_sm" ON "normal_sm".id = "p".id AND "normal_sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "p".id AND "protein"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000') INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "thromb" ON "thromb".id = "p".id AND "thromb".thrombosis <> 0 WHERE "thromb".id IS NULL AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rbc IS NOT NULL AND ("l".rbc <= 3.5 OR "l".rbc >= 6.0) AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp <> '0' GROUP BY "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(oxygen_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "sb" ON "sb".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "bond" WHERE "bond_type" = '#') AS "triple_molecules" ON "triple_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE "element" IN ('p', 'br')) AS "phosphorus_or_bromine_molecules" ON "phosphorus_or_bromine_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "a".atom_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "sb" ON "sb".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type <> '-') = 0 THEN 'all bonds single' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_groups" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'all bonds single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "pair_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c"."atom_id" = "a1"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c"."atom_id2" = "a2"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" WHERE "m"."label" = '+' AND "b"."bond_type" = '=' AND "a1"."element" = 'c' AND "a2"."element" = 'c' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT atom_id FROM (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected") AS "u"), "element_counts" AS (SELECT "p".element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_count" FROM "plus_atoms" AS "p" INNER JOIN "bonded_atoms" AS "b" ON "b".atom_id = "p".atom_id GROUP BY "p".element), "max_count" AS (SELECT MAX(bonded_count) AS "n" FROM "element_counts"), "plus_atom_total" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "plus_atoms") SELECT "e".element, ROUND("e".bonded_count * 100.0 / "t".n, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "element_counts" AS "e" CROSS JOIN "max_count" AS "x" CROSS JOIN "plus_atom_total" AS "t" WHERE "e".bonded_count = "x".n LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT bond_type AS "bond type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c') AS "cc" GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY CASE bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT "element_owner".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "element_owner" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "other_molecule" WHERE "other_molecule".element = "element_owner".element AND "other_molecule".molecule_id <> "element_owner".molecule_id)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "n" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "bad" ON "bad".molecule_id = "n".molecule_id WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "bad".molecule_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

WITH "triple_bond_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "bond" WHERE "bond_type" = '#'), "counts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m"."label" = '+') AS "carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m"."label" = '-') AS "non_carcinogenic_count" FROM "triple_bond_molecules" AS "t" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m"."molecule_id" = "t"."molecule_id") SELECT ROUND(100.0 * carcinogenic_count / NULLIF(carcinogenic_count + non_carcinogenic_count, 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * non_carcinogenic_count / NULLIF(carcinogenic_count + non_carcinogenic_count, 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_element_counts" AS (SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element), "rare_carcinogenic_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, "a".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule_element_counts" AS "ec" ON "ec".element = "a".element INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "ec".molecule_count = 1 AND "m".label = '+'), "rare_atom_bond_counts" AS (SELECT "r".molecule_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "rare_carcinogenic_atoms" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "r".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "r".atom_id GROUP BY "r".molecule_id) SELECT molecule_id, bond_count FROM "rare_atom_bond_counts" ORDER BY molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "carbon_touching" AS (SELECT "a1".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a1".molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "carbon_touching" AS "ct" ON "ct".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "atom" AS "yttrium" ON "yttrium".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "yttrium".element = 'y' AND ("a1".element = 'h' OR "a2".element = 'h') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND (("a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element <> 'c') OR ("a2".element = 'c' AND "a1".element <> 'c')) GROUP BY CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("a1".element, "a2".element)) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "a".element, "a".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".element, "a".atom_id HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "saturated_atoms" GROUP BY element ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element AS "element_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
